papers.title: Stochastic collocation on unstructured multivariate meshes
papers.abstract: Collocation has become a standard tool for approximation of parameterized systems in the uncertainty quantification (UQ) community. Techniques for least-squares regularization, compressive sampling recovery, and interpolatory reconstruction are becoming standard tools used in a variety of applications. Selection of a collocation mesh is frequently a challenge, but methods that construct geometrically "unstructured" collocation meshes have shown great potential due to attractive theoretical properties and direct, simple generation and implementation. We investigate properties of these meshes, presenting stability and accuracy results that can be used as guides for generating stochastic collocation grids in multiple dimensions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的随机配点方法可转移到生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化中，但未涉及具体应用。
llm.why_not_core: No implant design, no FEA validation, no biomedical context; purely theoretical UQ methodology on unstructured meshes.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决参数化系统近似中的不确定量化配点网格选择问题。
summary_zh.method: 研究非结构化配点网格的稳定性与精度，提出生成多维网格的指导准则。
summary_zh.result: 证明了非结构化网格具有良好的理论性质和生成简便性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of selecting collocation meshes for approximation of parameterized systems in uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Investigated stability and accuracy of geometrically unstructured collocation meshes and provided guidelines for generating such grids in multiple dimensions.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated that unstructured meshes possess attractive theoretical properties and can be generated simply and directly.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis supplemented with numerical examples.

papers.title: Reproduction of Hip Offset and Leg Length in Navigated Total Hip Arthroplasty: How Accurate Are We?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Golden Jubilee National Hospital, Clydebank, Scotland, UK

corresponding_authors.name: Pregash Ellapparadja
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Golden Jubilee National Hospital, Clydebank, Scotland, UK

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注临床手术精度，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物界面分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanics modeling, FEA, implant mechanics, or quantification of stress shielding or micromotion; it is a clinical accuracy study of navigated THA.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估导航全髋置换术中髋偏距和腿长复位的准确性。
summary_zh.method: 分析导航系统记录的术中数据与术后影像测量结果。
summary_zh.result: 导航系统可精确复位髋偏距和腿长，误差在3mm以内。
summary_zh.validation: 临床患者数据对比手术前后影像学测量。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the accuracy of navigated total hip arthroplasty in reproducing hip offset and leg length.
summary_en.method: Intraoperative navigation data were compared with postoperative radiographic measurements.
summary_en.result: Navigated THA achieved precise restoration of hip offset and leg length with errors less than 3 mm.
summary_en.validation: Clinical patient data validated against radiographic measurements.

papers.title: Readmission Rates in Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Granular Analysis?
papers.first_author_affiliation: The Center for Advanced Orthopedics at Larkin Hospital, South Miami, Florida

corresponding_authors.name: Carlos J. Lavernia
corresponding_authors.affiliation: The Center for Advanced Orthopedics at Larkin Hospital, South Miami, Florida

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注全髋关节置换术后的再入院率，未涉及生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is purely clinical outcomes research with no biomechanics modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no implant design analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析全髋关节置换术后再入院率及其相关因素
summary_zh.method: 对患者数据进行细粒度回顾性分析
summary_zh.result: 识别出再入院的关键风险因素
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床数据集的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To analyze readmission rates and associated factors following total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A granular retrospective analysis of patient data was conducted.
summary_en.result: Key risk factors for readmission were identified.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis based on a clinical dataset.
